19: /**
20:  * Request ID Middleware for Hono.
21:  *
22:  * @param {object} options - Options for Request ID middleware.
23:  * @param {number} [options.limitLength=255] - The maximum length of request id.
24:  * @param {string} [options.headerName=X-Request-Id] - The header name used in request id.
25:  * @param {generator} [options.generator=() => crypto.randomUUID()] - The request id generation function.
26:  *
27:  * @returns {MiddlewareHandler} The middleware handler function.
28:  *
29:  * @example
30:  * ```ts
31:  * type Variables = RequestIdVariables
32:  * const app = new Hono<{Variables: Variables}>()
33:  *
34:  * app.use(requestId())
35:  * app.get('/', (c) => {
36:  *   console.log(c.get('requestId')) // Debug
37:  *   return c.text('Hello World!')
38:  * })
39:  * ```
40:  */
41: export const requestId = ({
42:   limitLength = 255,
43:   headerName = 'X-Request-Id',
44:   generator = () => crypto.randomUUID(),
45: }: RequestIdOptions = {}): MiddlewareHandler => {
46:   return async function requestId(c, next) {
47:     // If `headerName` is empty string, req.header will return the object
48:     let reqId = headerName ? c.req.header(headerName) : undefined
49:     if (!reqId || reqId.length > limitLength || /[^\w\-=]/.test(reqId)) {
50:       reqId = generator(c)
51:     }
52: 
53:     c.set('requestId', reqId)
54:     if (headerName) {
55:       c.header(headerName, reqId)
56:     }
57:     await next()
58:   }
59: }

23:  * @param {number} [options.limitLength=255] - The maximum length of request id.
24:  * @param {string} [options.headerName=X-Request-Id] - The header name used in request id.
25:  * @param {generator} [options.generator=() => crypto.randomUUID()] - The request id generation function.
26:  *
27:  * @returns {MiddlewareHandler} The middleware handler function.
28:  *
29:  * @example
30:  * ```ts
31:  * type Variables = RequestIdVariables
32:  * const app = new Hono<{Variables: Variables}>()
33:  *
34:  * app.use(requestId())
35:  * app.get('/', (c) => {
36:  *   console.log(c.get('requestId')) // Debug
37:  *   return c.text('Hello World!')
38:  * })
39:  * ```
40:  */
41: export const requestId = ({
42:   limitLength = 255,
43:   headerName = 'X-Request-Id',
44:   generator = () => crypto.randomUUID(),
45: }: RequestIdOptions = {}): MiddlewareHandler => {
46:   return async function requestId(c, next) {
47:     // If `headerName` is empty string, req.header will return the object
48:     let reqId = headerName ? c.req.header(headerName) : undefined
49:     if (!reqId || reqId.length > limitLength || /[^\w\-=]/.test(reqId)) {
50:       reqId = generator(c)
51:     }
52: 
53:     c.set('requestId', reqId)
54:     if (headerName) {
55:       c.header(headerName, reqId)
56:     }
57:     await next()
58:   }
59: }

+describe('Request ID Middleware with trustIncoming option', () => {
+  const app = new Hono()
+  app.use('/trusted', requestId({ trustIncoming: true }))
+  app.use('/untrusted', requestId({ trustIncoming: false }))
+  app.use('/untrustedGenerator', requestId({ trustIncoming: false, generator: () => 'generated-id' }))
+  app.get('/trusted', (c) => c.text(c.get('requestId') ?? 'No Request ID'))
+  app.get('/untrusted', (c) => c.text(c.get('requestId') ?? 'No Request ID'))
+  app.get('/untrustedGenerator', (c) => c.text(c.get('requestId') ?? 'No Request ID'))
+
+  it('Should use the incoming request id when trustIncoming is true', async () => {
+    const res = await app.request('http://localhost/trusted', {
+      headers: {
+        'X-Request-Id': 'hono-is-hot',
+      },
+    })
+    expect(res).not.toBeNull()
+    expect(res.status).toBe(200)
+    expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toBe('hono-is-hot')
+    expect(await res.text()).toBe('hono-is-hot')
+  })
+
+  it('Should ignore the incoming request id when trustIncoming is false', async () => {
+    const res = await app.request('http://localhost/untrusted', {
+      headers: {
+        'X-Request-Id': 'hono-is-hot',
+      },
+    })
+    expect(res).not.toBeNull()
+    expect(res.status).toBe(200)
+    expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toMatch(regexUUIDv4)
+    expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).not.toBe('hono-is-hot')
+    expect(await res.text()).toMatch(regexUUIDv4)
+  })
+
+  it('Should use the generator when trustIncoming is false', async () => {
+    const res = await app.request('http://localhost/untrustedGenerator', {
+      headers: {
+        'X-Request-Id': 'hono-is-hot',
+      },
+    })
+    expect(res).not.toBeNull()
+    expect(res.status).toBe(200)
+    expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toBe('generated-id')
+    expect(await res.text()).toBe('generated-id')
+  })
+
+  it('Should generate a request id when trustIncoming is false and no header is sent', async () => {
+    const res = await app.request('http://localhost/untrusted')
+    expect(res).not.toBeNull()
+    expect(res.status).toBe(200)
+    expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toMatch(regexUUIDv4)
+    expect(await res.text()).toMatch(regexUUIDv4)
+  })
+})

part.text:
Done. Changes:

**`src/middleware/request-id/request-id.ts`**
- Added `trustIncoming?: boolean` to `RequestIdOptions`.
- Defaulted it to `true`, preserving existing behavior.
- When `false`, the incoming header is skipped entirely (`reqId` starts as `undefined`), so the configured `generator` always runs. The value is still set via `c.set('requestId', ...)` and written to the response header.

**`src/middleware/request-id/index.test.ts`**
- Added a `trustIncoming` describe block covering:
  - `true`: incoming header is used.
  - `false`: incoming header is ignored and a generated UUID is used.
  - `false` with a custom generator: generator output is used.
  - `false` with no incoming header: generated UUID is used.

Verification: `pnpm exec vp test --run src/middleware/request-id/index.test.ts` → **15 tests passed**. Also ran the formatter on the touched files.
